messages:
Rita: Quick pet photo drop — Penny the parrot staged a Post-it stickup. She rearranged my reminders into a feathered haiku. pic: https://cdn.redwood.app/penny/3654321000_penny_postit.jpg
Jordan: LOL that is pure chaos poetry. also: who taught her sticky notes? :laughing:
Sam: looks like a modern art installation. title: "Reminder, Squawk"
Felipe: also, is that one that says "standup" relocated to the plant? we might have a new standup ritual.
Rita: yes she moved "standup 10am" onto the philodendron and left a smudge of beak-art. Uploaded video of the heist: https://cdn.redwood.app/penny/3654321000_heist.mov
uploader-bot: Uploaded file "penny_postit_heist.mov" 2094 https://cdn.redwood.app/penny/3654321000_heist.mov
Jordan: watched it. 0:07 when she squeaks and then puffs fluff = chef's kiss. :ok_hand:
Sam: poll time: do we allow Penny to curate the office Kanban? :thumbsup: yes | :thumbsdown: no
Felipe: :thumbsup: yes for morale
Jordan: :thumbsdown: only if she attends retro and provides actionable feedback
Rita: saving this thread for posterity and for evidence if she tries to move my calendar again.
